name: hb
sql: select count(*) total, count(*) filter (where ok) ok_n, count(*) filter (where not ok) fail_n, min(observed_at) first_at, max(observed_at) latest_at, max(observed_at) filter (where ok) latest_ok, now() db_now from public.ten216_test_polls where poll_id <> 'selftest'

name: hb_gaps
sql: select prev_at, observed_at, observed_at-prev_at gap from (select observed_at, lag(observed_at) over (order by observed_at) prev_at from public.ten216_test_polls where ok) x where observed_at-prev_at > interval '10 minutes' order by 1

name: hb_per_hour
sql: select date_trunc('hour',observed_at) h, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where ok) ok from public.ten216_test_polls group by 1 order by 1

name: watch_state
sql: select public.ten216_collector_check(now()) as check_now, (select exists(select 1 from public.ten216_test_polls where ok)) has_hb, (select max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes) newest_change

name: watch_log
sql: select id, at, condition, kind, channel, delivered, left(message,160) msg from public.ten216_watch_log order by id

name: watch_cron
sql: select status, count(*), min(start_time), max(start_time) from cron.job_run_details where jobid=(select jobid from cron.job where jobname='ten216-collector-watchdog') group by 1

name: watch_cron_last
sql: select status, return_message, start_time from cron.job_run_details where jobid=(select jobid from cron.job where jobname='ten216-collector-watchdog') order by start_time desc limit 3

name: pm_log
sql: select delivered, condition, count(*), min(at), max(at) from public.postmatch_alert_log group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: pm_open
sql: select condition, is_open, opened_at, last_sent_at, left(detail,200) from public.postmatch_alerts

name: vault_names
sql: select name from vault.secrets where name like '%telegram%' order by 1

name: crons
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by 1
